notes.title: Alien Colosseum Update: Story or Action Mode & Reduced Fighter Fees
notes.notes:
Greetings, champions!

I’ve just released a new update for Alien Colosseum to give you more control over how you play and to make training your squad faster and more accessible. Here’s what’s new:

New Game Mode Options: When starting a new game, you can now choose between...

[list]
[*] Story Mode: Perfect for new players, this mode includes the full tutorial and introduces the lore of the colosseum.
[*] Action Mode: Designed for those who want to dive straight into the action, skipping the story and tutorial for a faster start.
[/list]
Reduced Fighter Costs: Training your squad just got easier! I reduced the in-game cost for additional fighters, so you can quickly explore all the unique classes and dominate the arena.

This update is all about giving you more choice and control over how you play. As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable—email me at cole@firstplayerstudios.com or join the discussion on our Steam community board.

Thanks for playing, and I hope you enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Alien Colosseum Update: UI Overhaul, Navigation Fixes, and More!
notes.notes:
Hello, gladiators!

We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for Alien Colosseum, packed with improvements to make your experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Enhanced UI Layout and Animations: We’ve reworked the interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience and added some snazzy animation tweaks.
[*] Enemy Navigation Fixes: You’ll notice smarter enemy movements and fewer navigation hiccups in the heat of battle.
[*] Quality of Life Improvements: From bug fixes to small gameplay adjustments, we’re polishing up your arena adventures.
[/list]
We’re always looking to make Alien Colosseum the best it can be! Got ideas or features you'd love to see? Drop me an email at cole@firstplayerstudios.com or share your thoughts on our community board here on Steam.

Thanks for being part of this journey, and keep conquering the colosseum!

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:

[*] Added level requirements to armor
[*] Target will switch once current target is defeated
[*] Added new armor set: Titanium 
[*] Slight changes to dodging with improved animations and camera stability 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 10th 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]Camera Tweaks[/h3]
I noticed the camera was a bit jittery when switching targets and if the enemy was too large then they would not be in the frame fully so I tried to fix this
[list]
[*] Added transition time to camera when target switching in combat
[*] Made it so the height of the enemy affects the pivot and initial zoom of camera
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update
notes.notes:
First of all, I apologize for the lack of consistent updates or announcements. The holidays were a tough time for me this year which contributed to some delays. However, I have been working on this next update for awhile and I think it is time to share with everyone. If you have access to the beta I am currently testing the final build on there but I am expecting to be releasing to the public by Friday. 

This update will feature a new mode called "adventures" where you will explore a new area with your fighter to defeat new enemies, find resources and equipment. Hopefully this will add a change of pace between fighting in the arena and provide a framework for different types of gameplay mechanics to be explored. 

I will post a major update announcement when it is ready to download. For now, here are some pictures of the first area that will be available to explore.

notes.title: Demo Release for Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Alien Colosseum will be participating in the Steam Next Fest at the beginning of October, starting on the 3rd! 

To allow potential customers a chance to experience the game before entering early access I have prepared a demo to play. This will show off the fighting mechanics, skills, and management gameplay for training a fighter to win in the arena. 

Some gameplay features will be restricted to the full game but I hope this is an enjoyable experience for any who decide to play!

If you are interested in purchasing the game when it becomes available, ensure to add Alien Colosseum to your Wishlist today,
